name: locks-in-main-test-617c6c002d/simple-lock-v.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: "Lock statement" is supported; named worker declarations are not listed.
## Expressions: "Start action" and "Wait action" are supported.
## Module-level declarations: "Annotation declarations and attachments" supports source-only, runtime, marker and repeated annotations.
reason: The asserted final counter value depends on a named worker w1 executing and completing before the main strand continues. Named worker declarations and their concurrent execution are not included in the supported positive lists; support for lock statements, wait actions and annotation attachments does not establish support for named workers or the strand thread setting.
unsupported_constructs: Named worker declaration and execution: worker w1
test_design_notes: The assertion observes worker completion and shared counter updates after wait; the busy-wait loops alone do not prove that competing critical sections exclude each other.
